## About
At Old West Animal Hospital, we are dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality veterinary care for your beloved pets. We strive to build lasting relationships with our clients and their furry family members, with personalized attention at every visit.
Dr. Kevin Mondon is a graduate of Texas A&M University and has practiced veterinary medicine in the Mansfield area for a long time. He is active in the Mansfield community, enjoys sports and time with his family, and has dogs named Bella and Birdie and a cat named Mikey.
Haley and Kelli assist Dr. Mondon. Haley has extensive pet grooming experience, and Kelli is active in competitive obedience and protection training with her dog Kazian. Our clients have rated us 4.7 from 87 Google reviews.

## Services
- Wellness Care: A thorough physical exam focused on preventive medicine and early detection, whether your pet needs an annual exam and vaccines or has an illness or injury.
- Bloodwork through IDEXX Reference Laboratories: Lab work sent through IDEXX Reference Laboratories to help find out what is going on with your pet.
- Digital X-rays: Digital X-rays taken in office, with external radiologist review available depending on the exam.
- General Surgery (Ex: Spay/Neuter): General surgery such as spays and neuters, along with soft tissue surgery and mass removals.
- Dental Cleanings and Extractions: Cleanings and extractions to keep your pet's mouth healthy.
- Heartworm and Flea Prevention: Monthly heartworm and flea prevention for dogs and cats, including Barrier, Heartgard Plus, Interceptor Plus and Bravecto.
- Euthanasia Services: A gentle, dignified process that supports both your pet and your family, with understanding, privacy and support at each step.
- Cremation Services: A respectful way to honor your companion, handled with sensitivity and dignity. Private or communal cremation is available.

## FAQ
Q: What forms of payment do you accept?
A: We accept cash, checks, VISA, MC, AMEX, DISCOVER and CareCredit.

Q: Does my pet need to be seen before I pick up a prescription?
A: Yes. Prescription products require your pet to be seen before we can dispense them.

Q: Do you carry prescription diets?
A: Yes. We carry a variety of Royal Canin prescription diets in the office.

Q: How will I know if you're closed?
A: Our answering machine is updated for closures due to holidays, vacations or illness. Closures for bad weather may not always make it onto the message, so give us a call if you're unsure.
